toegepas.voor: stilgehou vir vars water en kos
toegepas.na: stilgehou om vars water en kos te kry
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'stilhou vir' follows the English 'stop for'; an om...te-clause is the natural Afrikaans construction, and the protected wording before it stays intact.
toegepas.fout: 'stilgehou vir' copies English 'stop for' and can read as stopping for someone; written Afrikaans states the purpose with om...te.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The om...te-clause keeps the same purpose (ships stopped to get fresh water and food), reads more naturally, and leaves the protected wording 'Daarom het skepe by die Kaap stilgehou' intact.

toegepas.blok: Siekte en gevaar op die see
toegepas.rede_vinder: The other two items in the list are plural, so 'skipbreuk' should be plural too for a parallel list.
toegepas.fout: 'skipbreuk' stands singular between two plural items, so the list is not parallel.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'skipbreuke' matches 'Storms' and 'ongelukke' in the list without changing what the sentence says.

laat_vaar.na: Op een en dieselfde skip het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Op een skip' can be read as 'on one particular ship'; 'een en dieselfde' makes clear that men from many countries worked together on a single ship.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Op een skip' already reads naturally as 'on a single ship' after the opening sentence, and 'een en dieselfde' only makes the sentence heavier for a Grade 6 reader.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Min plek en werk in wagte
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die dissipline aan boord was hard.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die dissipline aan boord was streng.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Harde dissipline' is good Afrikaans and carries harshness, while 'streng' narrows it to strictness, so the meaning would move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'droog gepak' reads as 'packed dry'; 'gedroog' says the food was dried, parallel to 'gesout'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'droog of gesout gepak' reads naturally, and 'gedroog' narrows it to food that was dried, which does not fit hard biscuit as well as 'droog' does.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'die volgende' without a noun is elliptical; naming 'groep' makes the reference clear in an entry read on its own.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die volgende' clearly points back to ''n groep seemanne' in the same sentence, so the entry stands on its own, and a glossary definition should not be reworded for a lateral gain.
